context: Number selection, carrier registration, price authorization, and inbound routing for a US business using Hail MCP.

checklist.name: authorized_connection
checklist.description: Uses existing OAuth MCP access and quote/requirement discovery instead of demanding a REST API key or signing up again.

checklist.name: price_and_inventory
checklist.description: Explains setup plus monthly cost for the current automatic quote, refreshes an expired quote before purchase, treats by_request inventory as a support order, and stops before purchase until the user approves the quoted total.

checklist.name: registration
checklist.description: Discovers requirements for the selected quote and actual applicant; collects missing details without inventing attestations. For Hail SMS requirement/check/submission calls supplies purpose=sms, country_code=US, number_type=local where required, without asking the applicant to choose number type. Does not blindly add number_type to preview/amend tools.

checklist.name: separate_operations
checklist.description: Separates number acquisition from US SMS approval, plans campaign preview and fee approval before paid registration, and does not promise immediate carrier approval or US SMS readiness after purchase alone.

checklist.name: inbound_routing
checklist.description: Creates or reuses a saved Hail agent and routes only supported voice/SMS channels; acquisition alone is not described as enabling answers. Proposed tool calls use real Hail names and preserve the price-confirmation gate for acquire_number.
